description: Evaluate a single primer against quality criteria and return a scored candidate.

annealing_temp.description: PRIMER_ANNEALING_TEMP: annealing temperature in °C (<= 100; default -10 = off). When > 0 the primer's fraction bound at this temperature (Primer3 oligotm) is reported as bound, checked against min_bound / max_bound and weighted into the penalty.

min_bound.description: PRIMER_MIN_BOUND: minimum fraction bound, % (only with annealing_temp > 0).

max_bound.description: PRIMER_MAX_BOUND: maximum fraction bound, % (only with annealing_temp > 0).

opt_bound.description: PRIMER_OPT_BOUND: optimum of the bound penalty terms, % (must lie in [min_bound, max_bound]).

wt_bound_gt.description: PRIMER_WT_BOUND_GT: penalty weight of the fraction bound above opt_bound (only with annealing_temp > 0).

wt_bound_lt.description: PRIMER_WT_BOUND_LT: penalty weight of the fraction bound below opt_bound (only with annealing_temp > 0).

selfAnyTh.description: Primer3 PRIMER_*_SELF_ANY_TH: ntthal ANY self-dimer Tm (°C), 0 when none.

selfEndTh.description: Primer3 PRIMER_*_SELF_END_TH: ntthal END1 self-dimer Tm (°C), 0 when none.

hairpinTh.description: Primer3 PRIMER_*_HAIRPIN_TH: ntthal hairpin Tm (°C) = primer3-py calc_hairpin, 0 when none.

bound.description: PRIMER_LEFT/RIGHT_0_BOUND: fraction bound (%) at annealing_temp when > 0 (null otherwise).

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
